intro: Mi wan niu developa. Mi stap ronem seves blong hosting blong sava ASHIKA Network mo lis blong ol Minecraft sava SABALISU, mo mi stap mekem softwea blong Minecraft sava Storia.
about: Mi niu yet, be evri dei mi raetem kod mo mi stap kam gud moa
Mi ronem seves blong hosting blong sava blong mi wan
Ol kwestin abaot ol seves blong mi o teknoloji oli welkam: talem halo nomo long Discord
can_write: Wanem mi save raetem (wetem ol kod we i no stret gud)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: ol sava stat long 30 yen long wan manis
anw_p:
Wan seves blong hosting blong ol man we oli wantem ronem wan sava be oli no save spenem bigfala mani.
Stat smol, **stat long 30 yen nomo long wan manis**.
sab_t: SABALISU: wan lis blong ol Minecraft sava
sab_p:
Putum Minecraft sava blong yu long lis mo faenem ol man blong plei long hem.
I gud blong ol plea we oli stap lukaotem wan sava mo blong ol ona we oli wantem soemaot sava blong olgeta.
storia_t: Storia: softwea blong ol bigfala Minecraft sava
storia_p: Wan open-source fork blong Folia blong Minecraft 26.2. Wetem **Storia Cluster**, wan wol i save ron long plante sava long sem taem, mo ol plea oli muv bitwin olgeta i no gat loading skrin.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: wan wol we plante sava oli serem, wetem ol konekson we oli enkriptem
**Standbae relay**: namba tu relay i holem wan laef kopi mo i tekova sapos namba wan i lus
**Linear fomat**: ol wol oli yusum haf blong spes long disk nomo
**RAM wol**, **Tick Guard**, wan plugin API blong serem data, mo plante moa
